method: Frozen3.2 before maintainer reads fresh briefs/answers. Preserve the useful plain content while improving actionability and structure; contracts cannot invent exact-heading requirements.
selection: Fresh anonymous final reader checks factual/format/operational coverage, with no material usefulness or clarity loss. One narrow repair round with fresh check if a tradeoff needs repair; chosen bytes frozen unchanged.
judging: Four new contexts, j1/j2 briefA and i1/i2 independently authored briefB; all12 tasks, both views of both HTML versions.
gate: Strict majority wins overall and heldout, ties not wins; no mean clarity regression. No threshold or winner-rule changes after unblinding.
prior_rounds: P1v3,P2v2.1,P3v3.1 all preserved as failed. P3clarity improved+0.4375 but22/48wins failedmajority.
limits: Repeated development cycles; heldout set is fresh within this cycle, not a claim of statistical confirmation or customer outcomes.
selection_score_interpretation: A lower usefulness score against another usable candidate counts as material for this evaluation. A clarity/usefulness tradeoff requires the bounded repair and fresh check; no score-floor relaxation after outcomes.
